item.title: Valentine’s Day Giving Back With Catholic Charities NY
item.description: This Valentine’s Day, discover ways to share lasting love by giving back to your community and supporting Catholic Charities of New York.

item.title: Download Catholic Charities 2026 Lenten Prayer Calendar - Catholic Charities of New York
item.description: At Catholic Charities of New York, Lent is also a reminder of the profound dignity of every person we serve. Each day, we witness both hardship and resilience, struggle and hope. In this spirit, we are pleased to share our 2026 Lenten Prayer Calendar, created to accompany you through this meaningful season.

item.title: Mobile Food Pantries Bring Relief During Arctic Cold in the Bronx - Catholic Charities of New York
item.description: By 11 a.m. sharp, the line outside Tres Puentes Community Health Center in Mott Haven had already wrapped around the corner — but these Bronx residents were not waiting for a medical appointment.Instead, they stood patiently in the bitter cold for Catholic Charities of New York’s Mobile Food Pantry, part of the Feeding Our Neighbors program.

item.title: Thoughtful Stewardship & Lenten Legacy Planning
item.description: Explore how this Lenten season invites compassionate stewardship and legacy planning, aligning your faith with long-term giving.

item.title: The Pierre Toussaint Scholars Program: Forming Leaders, Black History Continuing To Be Made - Catholic Charities of New York
item.description: The Pierre Toussaint Scholars Program, a leadership and scholarship initiative in partnership with Catholic Charities of New York, supports a growing community of more than 90 scholars during the 2025–26 academic year, attending over 70 different colleges and universities across the country, including Fordham, Columbia, Cornell, Georgetown, Howard, Xavier U. of LA, and Yale. item.title: Charity in Action Newsletter - March 2026 - Catholic Charities of New York
item.description: Last month, we mark the installation of Archbishop Ronald A. Hicks as the 11th Archbishop of New York and honor Cardinal Dolan’s years of faithful leadership. We also lift up our advocacy efforts in Albany to strengthen support for vulnerable New Yorkers, invite you to plan your legacy with purpose, and share resources like our 2026 Lenten Prayer Calendar to guide your prayer and reflection. Together, we continue advancing faith in action across our community.

item.title: Facing Eviction in New York? The Eviction Prevention Grant Program (EPGP) Can Help - Catholic Charities of New York
item.description: Facing eviction or behind on rent in New York? Catholic Charities can help through the Eviction Prevention Grant Program (EPGP). Call 888-744-7900 for assistance.

item.title: People of Hope Mobile Museum to Debut in New York City at Union Square - Catholic Charities of New York
item.description: The People of Hope Mobile Museum visits New York City, sharing stories of faith, service, and compassion through Catholic Charities and communities across the country.

item.title: Now I Can Sleep Again: How Catholic Charities of New York Helped a Bronx Neighbor Keep Her Home - Catholic Charities of New York
item.description: A Bronx resident avoided eviction with help from Catholic Charities of New York through housing assistance, case management, and the One Shot Deal program.

item.title: Donor Profile: Tracy and Ted McCourtney - Catholic Charities of New York
item.description: Ted McCourtney and his wife, Tracy, have supported Catholic Charities of New York for more than five decades. They see their generosity as a simple way to live out the values of their Catholic faith.

item.title: Preventing Eviction in a Time of Crisis: How Catholic Charities of New York Helped a Harlem Neighbor Stay in Her Home - Catholic Charities of New York
item.description: Catholic Charities of New York helped a Harlem neighbor avoid eviction through rent assistance, housing stability services, and compassionate support during a medical crisis.
